questions.answer: Negotiation, Mediation and Sustainable Conflict Resolution. International Investment Arbitration. Law, Culture and Development. Competition Law. Smart Cities and AI.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Competition Law, since we had a great teacher. 
Negotiation, Mediation and Sustainable Conflict Resolution is a great interactive course.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Expect difficulty communicating with the university.
Plan for Fridays off from uni so you can travel.
Get used to Italian lunch hours. An no savory breakfast.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Go to B-cafe to meet other Italian student.
